assumptions: This is a read-only planning phase. The recovery snapshot is accurate: both P08 deliverables and tests/test_accounting_p08.py are absent; neither prior attempt contains a structured plan response.

Choose the issuer lifecycle of a simple compound convertible bond as the bounded operation slice. Revenue, tax, leases, FX and complex groups remain explicit method obligations; this slice cannot close MC06, MC15, MC17, MC19, MC29, MC30 or G4/G7/G8 generally.

Use synthetic facts, exact rational arithmetic, annual coupon periods and an Australian for-profit reporting basis within verified source applicability. AASB adoption is not universal IFRS jurisdiction authority.
Use existing Python and standard-library packages. No model launches, installations, protected-file changes, paid sources or professional engagement are needed.
checks: Before implementation, record the evidence contract and default audit in progress.md: question, existing dossier comparator, source-supported lifecycle acceptance criterion, authority/applicability and journal/state vetoes, explanatory diagnostics, nonclaims and planned artifacts. These are deterministic conformance checks, not a stochastic experiment or forecast comparison.

Run python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_accounting_p08.py' -v. Tests must exercise the actual parameterized implementation, with independently derived present-value and cash-flow expectations.

Run python3 -B scripts/check_accounting_p08.py --check. Require valid schemas, existing source paths, matching retained-byte hashes, resolvable claim/paragraph/note links, applicable editions, reproducible calculations and agreement between generated cases and deliverables.

Test issue, both coupon periods, redemption and maturity conversion; independently reconcile liability roll-forward, cash, interest expense, equity and share count. Test a second principal/rate configuration so hard-coded dossier outputs cannot pass.

Test missing authority, wrong jurisdiction, out-of-period editions, overview-only or company-policy support, unsupported contract features, duplicate/conflicting events, out-of-order accruals, repeated settlement, insufficient cash and failure atomicity.
Verify comparator cases share identical economic inputs. Unsupported standards must return an explicit unresolved result, never inherit another standard's treatment.

Before returning, verify all three required files exist, rerun checks after repairs, enumerate every changed file and compare protected-file hashes. Reserve the final 120 seconds for checks and reporting.

steps: 1. Preserve the recovery baseline. Create progress.md only in the implementation role. Record missing deliverables, relevant input hashes, declared new files and remaining checks. Use new scripts/corporate_financing_v1.py, scripts/check_accounting_p08.py and tests/test_accounting_p08.py; archive additional evidence under docs/design/research/p08-v1/. Do not change existing dossiers, shared engines, frozen corpus, controller or master plan.

2. Record the skeptical audit before implementation. The old dossier is an arithmetic regression comparator, not an accounting oracle; journal balance is necessary but insufficient. Material assumptions are synthetic contract eligibility, comparable yield, annual timing, reporting basis, edition selection and settlement funding. Record each assumption's provenance, failure mode and early check. Source failures veto affected claims, not independent preparation. Failed invariants veto implementation acceptance. This revised scope avoids treating a financing example as the complete corporate package.

3. Build authority-and-methods.json with versioned authority, claim, operation, comparison, research and follow-up records. Every authority record needs issuer, official URL, retrieval timestamp, retained path/hash, edition, jurisdiction/entity scope, effective-period and transition conditions, inspected paragraphs/pages, short supporting excerpts and access status. Distinguish inspected text, retained-but-uninspected text, overview, company practice and inaccessible authority. Resolve exact claims through authority IDs; never infer inspection from file presence.

4. Reinspect AASB 132 classification and conversion provisions and its compilation limits. Acquire and inspect applicable primary AASB 9 recognition, measurement, effective-interest and derecognition provisions before supporting the full lifecycle. Inspect applicable disclosure authority for any claimed mandatory note content. For US GAAP, investigate official FASB convertible-debt guidance, including ASU 2020-06 applicability and exceptions; for ASBE, investigate official Ministry of Finance financial-instrument recognition/measurement and presentation standards. Use bounded legitimate official routes, retaining successful bytes and failed-attempt metadata. Preserve known blocks; do not poll unchanged failed routes or bypass access controls.

5. Implement a narrow parameterized issuer operation engine. Inputs identify entity/book, jurisdiction, reporting periods, currency, contract, proceeds, principal, coupons, comparable yield, conversion shares and authority-backed treatment. Preconditions cover contractual-obligation recognition, qualifying fixed-for-fixed conversion, absence of unsupported settlement clauses, permitted measurement, valid chronology and sufficient cash. Implement atomic issue, accrual, coupon, redemption and maturity-conversion transitions with explicit postings, carrying amount, principal, conversion equity, issued shares and event identity. Reject tax, fees, FX, early conversion, modification, default and embedded-feature cases outside the inspected scope.

6. Produce exact multi-period cases dated within all selected editions. Use issue on 2024-01-01, coupons on 2024-12-31 and 2025-12-31, then alternative maturity settlements. Start with cash/equity 20 to fund redemption; proceeds/principal are 100, annual coupon 5, assumed comparable yield 10%, and conversion delivers ten shares. Independently derive initial liability 11050/121 and conversion equity 1050/121; subsequent liability after coupons is 1050/11 then 100, with total interest 2260/121. Expected ending cash is 10 for redemption and 110 for conversion. Generate journals, period movements and reconciled financing notes from the same state history. Label synthetic funding and yield explicitly.

7. Compare the identical contract under each actually supported standard and period. Hold proceeds, dates, coupons, conversion rights and market assumptions fixed; vary only inspected treatment rules. Explain paragraph-supported differences in initial liability/equity, interest and settlement, or supported agreement. Investigate the US single-liability treatment as a candidate requiring verification, not an assumed result. Leave unavailable cells null with exact missing authority/interpretation. No company-policy substitution or invented difference is permitted.

8. Address adopted research proportionately. Reinspect relevant retained ACTUS event/state/payoff sections for any adopted scheduling mechanism and official implementation where available. If adopting a company-simulation method, inspect its relevant technical, evaluation and appendix material first. Record exact support, transfer limits and source-specific inclusion/defer decisions; do not import behavioral parameters or forecast claims. No broad literature rediscovery is required.

9. Keep six explicit method-queue entries: revenue performance obligations/variable consideration; current/deferred tax and tax bases; lease recognition/options/remeasurement; FX transactions/translation/disposal; group control/acquisition/NCI/elimination/disposal; and remaining bond lifecycle features. Each entry identifies missing authority, proposed operation boundary, unresolved interpretation, next exact case and MC/G links. Write result.md with supported behavior, actual implementation, tests, authority limits, decision table, manifest, changed-file inventory and strongest alternative explanation. Embed check results in the declared deliverables; write no additional supervisor files.
plan.summary: Plan a source-supported compound-bond lifecycle with exact multi-period cases and matched standards comparisons, while preserving specific authority gaps and the wider corporate-method queue.
